title: Which lines are measured in the high-redshift spectra?
question: Which line measurements reach S/N above three, and how does lensing change their scale?
results: Line catalogue contains 48 solid/secure z>=6 objects
Most common S/N>=3 line: OIII-5007 (39 objects)
validation: Every line is screened by its reported uncertainty; magnification is shown as a scale correction with release intervals retained.
provenance: UNCOVER DR4.1 public release; Price et al. (2025)
limitations: Line fluxes are release fits and uncorrected for slit loss.
No abundance or luminosity is inferred.
